title: Battle of San Nicolás
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of San Nicolás", at revision 1375770288, opens: "The Battle of San Nicolás was a naval engagement on 2 March 1811 on the Paraná River between the Spanish royalists from Montevideo, and the first flotilla created by the revolutionary government of Buenos Aires. It was the first engagement between the two fleets in the Río de la Plata region since the revolution, and a royalist victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872286, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1811 naval battle between Spanish royalists and Buenos Aires revolutionary government". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
